arms.name: random_tail20_calibrated
arms.purpose: conservative allocation control receives one additional step and greater cost

method.training: same unscaled 87.5% dense-forward sparse-backward or ordinary dense training
method.averaging: uniform mean of the final 20 parameter states for every arm
method.calibration: after installing the average, fit one scalar temperature per arm with identical separate calibration data and LBFGS rule
method.final_holdout: used only for final evaluation, never temperature fitting
method.deployment: ordinary dense inference with averaged weights and fitted scalar temperature

validation.no_raw_trajectory_reproduction_gate: calibrated-tail is a new development method; raw trajectories are secondary and cannot replace the frozen calibrated-tail endpoint

cost_accounting.training: same realized-row CPU-calibrated 87.5% formula; dense pays full cost
cost_accounting.averaging_aux: one parameter copy per step plus twenty final parameter reductions per arm
cost_accounting.calibration_forward: eight forward-only calibration batches per arm
cost_accounting.calibration_aux: ten estimated operations per calibration logit per LBFGS closure evaluation

primary_endpoint: temperature-calibrated final uniform-tail dense held-out loss at full training-plus-averaging-plus-calibration cost

decision_rules.allocation_failure: calibrated low_max_abs does not beat calibrated random despite random receiving more steps and cost; stop
decision_rules.no_level_3: calibrated low_max_abs beats random but not calibrated dense; stop
decision_rules.development_level_3: calibrated low_max_abs loss is below random and dense while total cost is no greater than either
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

prohibited: fitting temperature on the final held-out set
changing tail length, calibration data, steps, or fitting rule after launch
launching body 7 without a development-level calibrated win
